beforeFinaleNote: Do these 7 before the final mission: they need a partner outing, a one-time story moment, or a single-chance event. Everything else can be finished in free roam afterwards.
builtFrom: The official trophy descriptions as published by PlayStation, listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. No stage invents a mission, location or count the descriptions do not give; where a detail is not pinned down by a description, the stage says so.
note: Order matters for one reason only: a handful of trophies need your partner beside you, or a story moment that may not come back. Everything else can be cleaned up in free roam after the story.

stages.goal: Finish the story and earn every chapter and named-mission trophy on the way.
tips: Play the missions in order; every chapter and named-mission trophy is unmissable.
Sample the activities as you meet them — one try at each of the 9 types feeds Master of None.
Do not rush the final mission: clear the partner trophies and one-time moments first.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story

stages.goal: Finish every side strand: the five contacts' final missions and 8 stranger strands.
tips: Take contact missions (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) as they appear.
Talk to every stranger you meet and finish their full strand — 8 strands, not 8 missions.
Take Bret's hunt when his strand offers it.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Side strands & contacts

stages.goal: Sweep the map's collectibles: cards, meditation spots, WAiNK locations, vehicles, areas and garages.
tips: Explore methodically, area by area — the 52 areas, the 18 meditation spots and the 100 WAiNK locations all reward the same sweep.
Pick up every card you see; three full sets is the target.
Drive everything you find: 100 distinct vehicles.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Collectibles & exploration

stages.goal: Clear the activity counts: shooting range golds, stunts, races, drone races, challenges and the rest.
tips: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges — retries are unlimited.
Win 20 different races and a drone race at all 14 locations.
Beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, and bowl at Kolt & Associates.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Activities & challenges

stages.goal: Money and mayhem: laundering, spending, vaults, trucks, gang operations and the wanted-level trophies.
tips: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts.
Rob 5 bank vaults and an armored truck — and escape every time.
Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Money & mayhem

stages.goal: Mop up the vague and one-time trophies, hit 100% completion, and the platinum pops.
tips: Watch for the one-time moments (Personal Best, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There) before the finale.
Check the in-game completion percentage — 100% is the last gold.
When the 54th trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! follows automatically.
